# package network

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/iec61850ctl/pkg/network"
```

Package network provides network scanning and discovery utilities for IEC 61850 devices.

## Functions

### func GetMACAddress

```go
func GetMACAddress(ip string) (string, error)
```

GetMACAddress attempts to resolve the MAC address for an IP using ARP. This may require root/admin privileges depending on the platform. Returns empty string and error if resolution fails.

### func ParseHostSpec

```go
func ParseHostSpec(hostSpec string) ([]string, error)
```

ParseHostSpec parses a host specification into a list of IP addresses. Supports:

  - CIDR notation: 10.0.0.0/24
  - IP range: 10.0.0.5-25
  - Single IP: 10.0.0.5

### func ScanTCP

```go
func ScanTCP(host string, port int, timeout time.Duration) bool
```

ScanTCP performs a TCP port scan on the given host and port.
